exposure: Ventilation requirements (high-frequency oscillatory, continuous positive airway pressure, invasive mechanical)
outcome: Intensive care unit duration of stay
Requirement of non-invasive and invasive mechanical ventilation
cohort: The study included 31 obstetric patients in the peripartum period with COVID-19 pneumonia who were admitted to the intensive care unit.
finding: Older maternal age, obesity, elevated LDH, AST, ALT, ferritin, leukocyte, CRP, and procalcitonin values, and severe lung involvement were identified as factors related to mortality.
